def VTask.prev {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : α :=
  let rec findFirstIndexAux (l : List α) (x : α) (h : x ∈ l) : ℕ :=
    match l with
    | [] => absurd h (List.not_mem_nil x)
    | (y::ys) =>
      if y == x then 0
      else let h_ys : x ∈ ys := by
              apply List.mem_of_mem_cons_of_ne h
              decide
           findFirstIndexAux ys x h_ys + 1
  let idx := findFirstIndexAux l x h
  let h_idx_lt : idx < l.length := by
    induction l generalizing x h
    case nil =>
      cases h
    case cons hd tl IH =>
      have h_cons : x ∈ hd::tl := h
      cases h_cons with
      | inr h_tl =>
        have ih_tl : findFirstIndexAux tl x h_tl < tl.length := IH _ h_tl
        calc findFirstIndexAux tl x h_tl + 1 < tl.length + 1 := by
          rw [Nat.succ_lt_succ]
          exact ih_tl
        ... := (Nat.lt_add_one _).le
      | inl h_eq => 
        exact Nat.zero_lt_succ _
  let h_nonempty : l.NonEmpty :=
    match l with
    | [] => absurd h (List.not_mem_nil x)
    | _ => ⟨⟩
  if idx = 0 then
    l.getLast h_nonempty
  else
    let i := idx - 1
    have h_pos : 0 < idx := by
      match idx with
      | 0 => contradiction
      | Nat.succ _ => exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by decide)
    have h_i_lt : i < l.length :=
      Nat.lt_trans (Nat.sub_one_lt_of_pos h_pos) h_idx_lt
    l.nthLe i h_i_lt
